Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <LM_OUTPUT>: The output of the language model.
# - <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>: The objective of the optimization task.
# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Are both giraffes' silhouettes and major anatomical contours rendered as chalk-drawn lines?
node.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' silhouettes and major anatomical contours are visibly constructed with chalk-like sketch strokes, broken or powdery lines, or rubbed linear marks rather than merely retaining photographic edges. Inspect the heads, necks, torsos and legs of each giraffe. Chalk lines may be fine, dark, pale or layered; they need not be uniformly rough. Fail if substantial contours on either giraffe remain photographic boundaries with only blur or a grain overlay. Interior shading and spot construction are assessed separately and cannot substitute for drawn contours. Return unknown only if visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
node.binding: Compare the supplied SOURCE and EDITED images for 'Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk.' Inspect both giraffes' silhouettes and major anatomical contours, especially the heads, necks, torso boundaries and legs. Determine whether their edges have been reconstructed as chalk-drawn lines rather than merely softened. Background treatment cannot satisfy this condition.
